name: Kimpton Clocktower, Manchester
insider_take: This boutique gem transforms Manchester's historic Refuge Assurance Building into a stylish urban sanctuary where Victorian grandeur meets contemporary cool.
whats_special: The hotel occupies the iconic 1895 Refuge Assurance Building, once the world's largest office building. The stunning clock tower that gives the hotel its name was Manchester's tallest structure for decades. Inside, original terracotta details and soaring ceilings blend seamlessly with Kimpton's signature eclectic design and complimentary evening wine hour.
pro_tip: Request a room facing Oxford Street for clock tower views, and don't miss the rooftop bar – it offers some of the best panoramic views of Manchester's skyline.
dont_miss: The hotel sits in the heart of Manchester's cultural quarter, steps from the Palace Theatre, Bridgewater Hall, and the vibrant Gay Village. The nearby Manchester Art Gallery houses pre-Raphaelite masterpieces, while the historic John Rylands Library – one of the world's most beautiful libraries – is just a 5-minute walk away.
pros: Historic Victorian architecture with iconic clock tower landmark
Prime city center location near Manchester's cultural attractions
Boutique luxury accommodations with personalized service
Pet-friendly policy with special amenities for furry companions
cons: Historic building may have limited modern amenities
Urban location with potential city noise
